notes.title: Update notes for January 3rd Patch (Traditional Chinese & Brazilian Portuguese)
notes.content: Added Traditional Chinese and BR Portuguese languages, plus a few other small fixes

notes.title: Pause Music, Camera Angles and Collectible Stats
notes.content:
Just before our game goes live to the world we added some little last minute touches we can up with at the most recent ISG annual retreat.

- We've added a tune to the pause screen to give the player some peace and positive affirmations before they recommence

- We've added some functionality to bumper buttons on control pads so that you can cycle between three preset camera angles

- We've added some stats to each page of the wardrobe section of the shop so that you can see how many of each article you have collected, and how many remain

We hope you enjoy these updates, don't forget if you want to see more, give us a lovely review here on Steam!

notes.title: Leaderboards update
notes.content:
Who likes leaderboards? We do! Since gazing mesmerised at the Commando high score table in a pub in Malvern and listening to that music that just says "enter your name please" - leaderboards have been an integral part of how we see the form and function of videogames.

3DDMR lends itself to leaderboards so easily because of its endurance based numerical score nature. But not every leaderboard is score! 

With this update every game mode, every coin collected - chances are they have their own leaderboard.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Animated enemies and visual improvements
notes.content:
Buckle up, the demo just got even better.

Now the enemies all have unique animations in-game, plus we've been making things look more and more pretty.

Hope you enjoy this update!

ps. we're getting VERY close to release x

- Team ISG
